# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Microsoft Edge Search Engine

Sets Google as the default search engine in Edge. An organisational decision, not a security setting.

|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | ADMX |
| Assignment | — |
